intent: Limited source/data/leg/exit/cost integration pilot only. Not intended to select or promote a profitable strategy; no hypothesis significance or winner ranking is reported.

market_data.cache: Hugging Face cache restored/saved by GitHub Actions; source data hashes are recorded per file. Raw market data are not committed to the public repository.

configuration_filter.configuration_ids: Generated only from the exact phase52-grid-v1.3 Cartesian enumerator and frozen filter; no new dimensions are introduced.

event_sampling.split_definition: Development: target expiry <= 2023-12-31; validation: target expiry 2024-01-01 through 2025-12-31; holdout from 2026-01-01 onward.
event_sampling.deterministic_rule: Within each development/validation × entry-time bucket, sort by target expiry and event_id, then select six evenly spaced rows using rounded linspace positions. No option-leg availability or strategy P&L is used to choose the events.
event_sampling.holdout: Deliberately excluded from performance output; it remains untouched and data-gated.

execution.eligible_exit_rule_only: 15:15_IST on the entry/target-expiry date with an exact 15:15 bar for every resolved leg.
execution.prior_oi: Unique exact T-1 minute selected-contract row with OI >= 100; entry-bar OI is diagnostic only.
execution.fill_reference: exact option-bar OPEN with adverse slippage; minute OHLC is a simulation reference, not bid/ask or tick execution.
execution.liquidity_gate: 100*(high-low)/open is an OHLC range proxy, not observed spread.
execution.unsupported_modes: All factor routers except BASELINE, ABS_DELTA until the audited resolver is fully bound into the production runner, non-15:15 exits, hedges and intraday-futures-dependent families remain fail-closed.

costs.statutory_charges: Date-aware kernel schedule, independently calculated and not scaled by slippage stress.

required_outputs: pilot_manifest.json with source/script/protocol fingerprints and all exact configuration/event IDs
event_replay.csv with one status row per configuration/event including every exclusion reason
cost_scenarios.csv with all six brokerage/slippage scenarios for each successfully executed event
config_split_summary.csv with descriptive-only split aggregates, executed/eligible counts, exclusions and all costs
source_file_audit.csv with per-file SHA256, revision, size and row/timestamp extent
report.md stating that this is an engineering pilot, not a selector efficacy test or confirmation study

promotion_policy.strategy_ranking: NONE; outputs are implementation/coverage diagnostics only.
promotion_policy.inference: No p-values, optimization, winner selection, or holdout claim from this pilot.
promotion_policy.next_gate: Only after this workflow passes its source/code fingerprint guard can wider development/validation replay be planned. Actual selector routers, alternate exit rules and holdout remain separate gates.
